Part 2&3 事件 EVENTS

Describe a time when you worked in a group

描述一次你团队合作的经验

⚠️ AI 范例，仅供学习 — IELTS 口语全程独立完成，背诵照搬 AI 答案会被考官识别为背稿。

Part 2 话题卡片

Describe a time when you worked in a group

  • What you did (你做了什么)
  • Who you worked with (你与谁一起合作)
  • What problems you faced (你遇到了什么问题)
  • And explain why you worked in the group (并解释你为什么团队合作)

问题与答案

Cue CardDescribe a time when you worked in a group

I'd like to talk about a time when I worked in a group to organise a film screening for our university film club. It happened in my second year, and it was one of the first big events I helped arrange. What I did was basically coordinate the whole thing. I was in charge of the schedule, which meant booking the room, picking a time that worked for most members, and making sure everything was ready on the day. I worked with a few classmates from the club, and we split the tasks, so some handled the posters and promotion while others dealt with the equipment. The main problem we faced was that one of our teammates arrived late on the day of the event. We'd planned to start the screening at seven, but he was the one holding the projector, so we had to delay the whole thing by about twenty minutes. I remember feeling quite stressed, because people were already seated and waiting. In the end, I had to quickly rearrange the order of the programme and start with a short introduction to fill the time. The reason I worked in the group, rather than doing it alone, is that an event like that simply needs more than one person. You need people to promote it, to set up the equipment, and to handle problems as they come up. Looking back, I think the experience taught me how important clear communication and backup plans are in teamwork.

我讲的是大二时和电影社团的同学一起组织一次观影活动。我负责统筹：订场地、定时间、当天确认一切就绪；队友们分工，有人做海报宣传、有人管设备。最大的问题是活动当天有个队友迟到，他拿着投影仪，我们只好推迟二十分钟，观众都坐好了，我很紧张，最后临时调整流程、先放了个简短介绍来填时间。之所以要团队合作，是因为这种活动一个人做不来，需要有人宣传、有人装设备、有人处理突发状况。这次经历让我明白沟通和备用方案在团队里有多重要。

Q2Why do some people prefer to work by themselves?

I think it mainly comes down to control and pace. When people work alone, they can decide their own schedule, and they don't have to wait for others or explain their choices. Some people also find group work frustrating, because the workload isn't always shared fairly, and disagreements waste time. Having said that, I think working alone suits certain tasks better, while group work is better for bigger projects, so it really depends on the situation.

主要在于掌控感和节奏。一个人做事能自己定时间，不用等别人、也不用解释自己的选择。还有人觉得团队合作烦人，因为分工不一定公平，争论也浪费时间。不过独立工作适合某些任务，大项目更适合团队，要看情况。

Q3What should a leader do to make team members want to follow him or her?

I'd say the most important thing is to communicate clearly, so everyone knows what they're responsible for and what the goal is. A good leader also listens to the team's ideas and gives credit where it's due, because people follow someone who respects them. In my experience, leaders who stay calm under pressure and solve problems quickly earn the most trust. So I think it's a combination of clear direction, fairness and reliability.

最重要的是沟通清楚，让每个人知道自己的职责和目标。好领导还会听团队的想法、该表扬就表扬，因为人们愿意跟随尊重自己的人。以我的经验，压力下保持冷静、能快速解决问题的领导最受信任。所以是明确方向、公平和可靠三者的结合。

Q4Should students learn to do group work?

Yes, I think it's essential, because almost every job today involves working with other people. Group work teaches students how to communicate, how to divide tasks, and how to handle disagreements, which are skills you can't learn from textbooks alone. In my country, employers often complain that graduates are technically strong but weak at collaboration, which shows how important this is. Having said that, group work should be well designed, so that everyone actually contributes.

是的，非常必要，因为现在几乎每份工作都要和人合作。团队作业教学生怎么沟通、怎么分工、怎么处理分歧，这些是课本学不来的。在我国，雇主常抱怨毕业生技术强但协作弱，可见其重要性。不过团队任务要设计好，保证每个人都真正出力。

Q5What group tasks are there in schools?

There are quite a few. The most common one is group projects, where students research a topic together and present it as a team. Schools also organise group activities like sports competitions, drama performances and club events, such as our film club's screenings. In science classes, students often do experiments in small groups as well. So I'd say group tasks are everywhere in schools, and they all aim to teach students how to cooperate.

挺多的。最常见的是小组作业，一起研究一个主题再上台展示。学校还有体育比赛、戏剧表演、社团活动这类团队任务，比如我们电影社团的观影活动。理科课上学生也常分组做实验。可以说学校里的团队任务无处不在，目的都是教学生合作。

Q6待补充

I'd say it depends on the task. For simple tasks, working alone is usually faster, because there's no need to coordinate or discuss. But for complex projects, group work can be more efficient, since different people bring different skills, and tasks can be done in parallel. Having said that, group work only becomes efficient when the team is well organised, because poor communication can actually slow everything down. So on the whole, it's not the group itself, but how it's managed, that decides efficiency.

要看任务。简单任务独自做更快，不用协调讨论；复杂项目团队更高效，因为不同人带来不同技能，还能并行推进。但团队只有在组织良好的时候才高效，沟通不畅反而拖慢一切。所以决定效率的不是团队本身，而是怎么管理。
